purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: Rabat
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Rabat urban area and Rabat-Salé region; ANCFCC is Morocco's national land registry, cadastre, and mapping agency with local service offices.
registryBasis: ANCFCC says it establishes and maintains the national cadastre, publishes digital/analog cadastral information, and offers an online cadastral-plan request; the service requires personal/identity details, title/cadastre, CAPTCHA and payment steps. Rabat-Salé urban agency publishes planning information, not parcel geometry.
findings: Rabat's official national cadastre authority is established and local offices are documented. The available plan-cadastral service is a document-order workflow requiring identity information, title number, CAPTCHA, phone/SMS verification, and payment, so it is not an anonymous geometry service; I did not enter or bypass those controls. A Rabat urban-planning geoportal is not evidence of property parcel polygons. No open WFS/feature service was found.
